message: 熱病の夜

name: Synn
message: 「Mmm... It's kinda warm...」
Crap! I fell asleep!
Even though I'm supposed to be taking care of Azel...
「Don't get up」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」
「Don't get up. Stay in bed」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel!? *cough, cough*」
Azel's face is right in front of mine!?

name: Azel
message: 「I said stay in bed」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-Why is sleeping next to Azel me!?」

name: Azel
message: 「What are you saying. Did the fever fry your brain?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, that's not what I meant--why is Azel sleeping next to me!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Because you looked unwell. I couldn't leave my housemate alone while suffering」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Housemate? Don't say things that invite misunderstandings」

name: Azel
message: 「Then, living under the same roof」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not quite right either...」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not like I was worried about you」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, I see...」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes」

name: Synn
message: 「...Right, of course」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't just accept it」

name: Synn
message: 「Which is it...?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not worried」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not the issue! You were the one looking like you were in so much pain, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm fine」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the one who should be sleeping, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「I am sleeping」

name: Synn
message: 「I know, but if so, do it in your own room」

name: Azel
message: 「You would worry about me and sneak out of your futon」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No... I wouldn't do that」

name: Azel
message: 「A lie. Look me in the eyes and say that」
Azel leaned her face right up close to mine!

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph. You looked away」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, because you--」
Azel's hands pressed against both of my cheeks.

name: Azel
message: 「Right now, I am not the issue」
Her warm breath tickled my cheek.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel, h-hey, hold on!」

name: Azel
message: 「Do not dodge the question」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you hate sleeping with me that much?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sleeping together!?」
A young guy and girl all alone together!?
I'm sure Azel doesn't have the slightest bit of that kind of intention, though...

name: Azel
message: 「Do you hate it?」
With a sudden lean, Azel moved in closer again. Her eyelashes are so long and pretty...

name: Azel
message: 「Is there something on my face?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I mean, uh」

name: Azel
message: 「Answer me. Do you hate it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not that I hate it!」
There's no way I'd hate having the girl I like worry about me, though.

name: Azel
message: 「Then you welcome it. In that case, there is no problem」
What kind of leaps-in-logic is that!?

name: Synn
message: 「There is a problem!」

name: Azel
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not that I hate it or anything, it's just, in the same futon, um, well」

name: Azel
message: 「I properly took off my socks before sleeping.」

name: Synn
message: 「Bare legs!? No, I mean, look, um」

name: Azel
message: 「Besides, there is no heater here. I am the substitute.」

name: Synn
message: 「That makes no sense! W-W-Whoa!」
O-Our foreheads are touching! And she's burning up!?

name: Azel
message: 「Why are you surprised? I heard you check a fever by touching foreheads.」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But you don't have to press them together like this!?」
Azel's face is right in front of mine. Her lips, too.

name: Azel
message: 「That is a terrible fever. Are you alright?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the one with a terrible fever, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「I am worried about you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I'm even more worried about you, Azel! I just happened to catch a cold today, but you've been like this constantly lately!」

name: Azel
message: 「It is merely my constitution.」

name: Synn
message: 「Running a fever that high isn't just your constitution!」

name: Azel
message: 「It is my constitution.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even right now, you're this hot without any heating」

name: Azel
message: 「It is your imagination.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not my imagination!」
Oh, whatever.
Shaking off my embarrassment, I pressed my forehead against Azel's.

name: Azel
message: 「W-W-What are you doing!?」
Azel reflexively pulled back from me just a little.

name: Synn
message: 「I-I was just checking your fever too」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I know!」

name: Synn
message: 「You realize what you just did too, right, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's no big deal. I was merely checking your fever. That's all--I didn't do anything e-embarrassing!」

name: Synn
message: 「You stubborn blockhead!」

name: Azel
message: 「What did you say」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, you're even hotter than I am」

name: Azel
message: 「You're the one who's hotter」

name: Synn
message: 「You are, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「You are!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's you, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「It's you! You're the real blockhead here!」
Azel's hand rests on my shoulder. All at once, I'm pulled in close.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel!?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I'm not embarrassed at all. I'm simply worried about you, so there's no reason for me to be embarrassed. Th-That's all it is」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel……」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-What. Do you hate having me worry about you」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all」

name: Azel
message: 「Listen, let me worry about you every once in a while」

name: Synn
message: 「But」

name: Azel
message: 「You went along with me even though you were coming down with a cold?」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't think it was a big deal」

name: Azel
message: 「You ought to take better care of your body. It makes me worry」
Azel's hand touches my cheek…… so gentle.

name: Azel
message: 「Synn Sakura. You're far too reckless. Watching you makes me uneasy.」
Slender fingers slowly stroke my cheek.

name: Azel
message: 「Even today you're running such a high fever, and yet all you do is worry about me. You're a fool. A complete fool」
The eyes looking at me were slightly moist and trembling.

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe I am... huh」

name: Azel
message: 「I won't forgive you if you go and die on your own」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't die」

name: Azel
message: 「How could you know that? Humans are fragile creatures that die faster than the blink of an eye」
There's no way Azel would cry. Even so, it looked like they were on the verge of tears.

name: Synn
message: 「Got it... I'll behave today, so I'll let you worry about me all you want」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't make me worry in the first place」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I'll be careful」
I should give up on trying to chase Azel out of here.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey... is it okay if I just go to sleep like this?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's what I've been saying from the start」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right, you were」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, Azel. I'm just as worried about you as you are about me」

name: Azel
message: 「Wha--!? I'm way more worried about you」

name: Synn
message: 「Why can't it be the same?」

name: Azel
message: 「When I'm worrying this much, there's no way it's the same! If you were to die, I--」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh, k-kghh」
Azel let out a groan, clutched their chest, and curled up.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel!? What's wrong?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's nothing! It'll pass in a little while」
That small body was trembling slightly.

name: Synn
message: 「Because you look like you're in pain」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up, be quiet. I'm the one worrying about you」

name: Synn
message: 「But you're the one who's」

name: Azel
message: 「You're the one hiding how much pain you're in, aren't you. Let me treat you」

name: Synn
message: 「Never mind about that!」

name: Azel
message: 「I know how to treat someone. There's no problem」

name: Synn
message: 「There should be some cold medicine somewhere……」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't run away」
My collar is grabbed firmly, and I'm pulled in close once again.

name: Azel
message: 「Lolotte told me that 'treatment' comes from placing your hands on the affected area. Let me do it」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Azel!?」
Azel's hand strokes my back.
Through my clothes, I can feel the heat of his palm.

name: Azel
message: 「Does it hurt here?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel……」
I open and close my mouth silently like a goldfish.
I can't resist. Is it because it's Azel's hand? Because it's Azel's fingers?

name: Azel
message: 「Or maybe around here……」
Moist eyes. Worrying about me.
Plenty of people have worried about me before. Looked out for me.
Nanaka, my parents, everyone on the Student Council.
But…… Azel felt different from anyone before.

name: Azel
message: 「Here? Tell me if anywhere hurts」
His fingers trace down my spine, across my shoulders, and then to my chest.
With an awkward yet gentle touch.
From his fingertips, heat spreads into my body like ripples.
Wait, heat……?

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!? You're burning up way worse than before!」

name: Azel
message: 「You only feel that way because you're the one who's hot」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it」

name: Azel
message: 「It's because you're hot. You are」
Azel presses in even closer to me, earnestly continuing his treatment.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel…… I'm fine, really……」

name: Azel
message: 「With your heart beating this fast, there's no way you're fine」

name: Synn
message: 「That's...」
My heart is racing because of Azel.
There's no way I could say that.

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Azel. Just sleeping together is enough, so you don't have to do anything like that...」

name: Azel
message: 「I won't be satisfied unless I do」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, you're burning up too, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not hot」

name: Synn
message: 「Liar」
I placed my hand on Azel's forehead.

name: Azel
message: 「Hyah, w-what are you...」

name: Synn
message: 「See, you're hot too, Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「You're sweating this much」

name: Azel
message: 「It's because you're hot」
Azel's hot fingers stroke my cheek.

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm not. You're hot too, Azel...」
Through our touching fingers, Azel's heartbeat resonates.
It's getting faster.

name: Azel
message: 「Yours is the one that's so...」
Azel's hand gently stroked my chest.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel...」

name: Azel
message: 「Fast and pounding... You're sick...」

name: Azel
message: 「Even your cheek... Mwah」
Soft, hot lips pressed against my cheek.
